Class SettingsData<T extends SettingsNode>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.settings.SettingsData<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the loadable settings node type
public class SettingsData<T extends SettingsNode> extends Object
Core class to load any settings node from data.

This is a class that unifies a SettingsSource as data reader and a node constructor to load the data into it.
